title: A log entry saved before the release reads one representative
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Use a work order for that customer, still open and not invoiced, whose Sales Representative was changed from sales rep A to sales rep B before the release was installed. That change wrote a "Sales representative changed" entry, and a version of the work order was saved to its history with sales rep B.
  • With the release installed, open the work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order's menu.
  2. Click Audit Log and find the entry written before the release.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order's menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The entry still reads "Sales Representative: [sales rep A's name] → [sales rep B's name]".
  • There is one name on each side of the arrow, with no (Parts) or (Labor).

The pre-release log entry exists only if Part Sales Update v1 (SV-10266, which adds that entry) was on the site before this release. If it was not, mark this case Blocked and say so.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11271 (Story 7, Record representative changes in the work order log)

  • S7-R2: “The entry shows "Sales Representative: {before} → {after}". A work order that is not split reads the one name, or "Unassigned".”

From: Tech plan "Splitting Sales Representatives — Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 14 Oct 2026, planned against PRD version 8; uploaded 19 Oct 2026 and again, byte-identical, 22 Oct 2026), read in full 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan, history log entry (section 5, 0.5): “`null` split (every entry before this release) reads as not split.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), page 1, board 1.19 "The log records every rep change", export read 19 Oct 2026. The PRD's Story 7 says "Design: none", yet this board shows the log; its wording is checked in the "Design — how it looks" case for the log.
